articleTitle: Model Explainability using SHAP Values for LightGBM Predictions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper aims at demonstrating the cutting-edge tool for machine learning models explainability leveraging LightGBM modelling. The proposed methodology improves inference performance, training time and significantly reduces the "fitting-to-noise" problem for complex datasets, and additionally, grants more insight into model predictions. Discussed methodology is versatile and finds applications in processing big data sets from different fields of science, ranging from econometry to medical or SHM applications, in which networks of MEMS sensors are used.

articleTitle: Development of the Architecture of the Base Platform Agricultural Robot for Determining the Trajectory Using the Method of Visual Odometry
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article analyzes the existing chassis designs for agricultural robots, proposes to use a wheeled mobile platform with elements of stabilization of the base platform with independent drives and with the possibility of steering each wheel. The paper presents a kinematic model of the robotic platform and the equation of kinematics of a platform to determine the speed of any point of the robot. The structural scheme of the motion control system of the selected platform design is developed. To determine the trajectory of the agricultural robot, it is proposed to use of a global positioning system in conjunction with a subsystem of visual odometry to accurately determine the local coordinates. Software was developed and an experimental study was conducted to determine the accuracy of movement on a given trajectory.

articleTitle: Thermal Calibration and Filtration of MEMS Inertial Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper deals with temperature calibration and filtration of rate gyroscopes developed by the technology of microelectromechanical systems. The measurement model is represented. Temperature calibration techniques both for rate gyroscopes and accelerometers are developed. The results of calibration of the zero bias due to temperature drift are shown. The filter of exponential smoothing has been developed. Results of the assessment of improving accuracy due to filtration are shown. Features of attitude determination are discussed. The possibilities of complementary filters are researched.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Eddy Current Damper
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Eddy currents are generated in a non-magnetic material as they move along stationary or time-varying magnetic fields. Eddy Current Damper (ECD) incorporates the phenomenon of eddy currents generation and is used for vibration attenuation. In the presented work, the design of an ECD with the use of high-energy rare earth magnets, ferromagnetic spacers, and an aluminum conductor has been discussed. ECDs are simple and mechanically robust. They do not need an external power supply and are simple to design. In this paper, finite element analysis and experimental validation of ECD have been presented. The damping force has been estimated by using finite element formulation with Lenz's law. Further, a prototype has been built with the use of high-energy rare earth magnets, and damping force generated along an aluminum conductor has been measured for harmonic excitations provided to ECD. It has been noticed that finite element simulation can estimate the damping force in ECD with an accuracy of 2.5 %.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation of Algorithms in a Sliding Mode System of Vector Control Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The possibility of creating a universal stand for the practical implementation and research new Closed-relay-robust control algorithms for functional and parametric uncertain electromechanical systems based on AC Motors is shown. At the program level, the implemented discontinuous control algorithms for a synchronous machine with excitation from permanent magnets when powered from the frequency converter Sinamics s120 are elaborayed.

articleTitle: Thermomechanical Behavior Computer Forecasting for Bimetallic Plates in their Magnetic Pulse Treatment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A physics-mathematical model of the thermomechanical behavior of a bimetallic plate under the action of a pulsed electromagnetic field is formulated. The initial boundary-value problems on the following key-functions are formulated: the component of the magnetic field strength vector tangential to the bases of the layer, temperature, and the normal to the bases of the layer of the component of the dynamic stress tensor. A computer analysis of the thermal stress state of this plate under the action of electromagnetic pulses of microsecond and millisecond durations has been performed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Parameters of Nanocomposite Hip Implants
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility of using nanocomposite materials in the field of biomedical engineering, in particular for the production of hip implants. The design model of biomedical implant has been developed by software means of engineering design and calculations. The material-intensive construction of the endoprosthesis was generated by the module of topological optimization of structures in shape and weight following the design criteria. The dependence of the parameters of the strength of the hip implant on its size and mass characteristics was investigated by the finite element method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Design of the Industrial Production Process Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article reviews the industrial production of polypropylene filter elements. One of the main problems of polypropylene fibrous filter elements production management is technological process control. Considering the large number of factors and parameters influencing the production process, 4 main ones were identified. And the filter element fiber thickness mathematical models that depend on the technological process parameters were created. Also the research of the created models was conducted.

articleTitle: Features of Porous Composites Dispersion Relations Simulation based on Voxel-like Microlevel Models and Supercell Approach in COMSOL System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: this paper presents an approach and set of finite element models for synthesis of dispersion relations of porous composite materials with complex structure basing on numerical simulation by COMSOL system of electromagnetic waves propagation in a frequency domain within the voxel-like microlevel structures of composites.

articleTitle: Software Development for the Monitoring System of Renewable Energy Generation Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of software development for systems that are implemented using Internet of things concepts, particularly, for renewable energy generation process control and monitoring. The aim of the article is to create flexible software that can be easily scaled after hardware components are added. Existing solutions were analyzed with highlighting of their advantages and disadvantages. Based on the aim for software that was being implemented and the existing hardware, the system level diagram was created, as well as the module structure of data aggregation unit. For server system component, the software structure was proposed and database structure was presented and explained. As the result, software complex for both data aggregation unit and server was implemented. The result of implementation is represented in form of web-oriented material design user interface. Created software is scalable, has intuitive interface and can be easily installed and configured for different hardware combinations.

articleTitle: Development of Multiband Flame Detector with Fuzzy Correction Block
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The main advantages of flame detector are high sensitivity and low inertia. The main limitation of the use of flame detector is the presence of artificial and natural electromagnetic interference it can respond to. The intelligent multiband flame detector with infrared and ultraviolet sensors is proposed using a fuzzy correction (FC) block synthesized on the basis of the fuzzy logic theory. The input values of the FC block are the values of the wavelength signals of infrared and ultraviolet radiation and the flame flicker frequency. The FC block processes these signals in accordance with the developed algorithm. A model of this multiband flame detector has been developed in the MATLAB software environment. The results of simulation studies have shown that the FC block distinguishes different stages of changes in the wavelength of infrared and ultraviolet radiation and the flicker frequency. The block forms the required output signal based on the compiled rule base. This makes it possible to detect a fire with high accuracy without false alarms.

articleTitle: Three types of PCB Defects and Image Processing Algorithms for their Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The known thinning and flood-fill algorithms are implemented in the approach. The template PCB image and the manufactured PCB image are used to determine coordinates of specific points: endings and switches. The flood-fill algorithm is used to mark traces and to detect defects of connectivity. The flood-fill algorithm also is used to detect background defects. Defects of traces are found and measured by mean intensity and gradient functions, which are applied to suspicious routes.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of a Laser Plotter as an Example of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Aim of the publication was to show the process of designing, building, and programing a laboratory laser plotter completed for educational applications. Another aim of the project was to show the possibility of using information technology in engineering education. The publication describes the issue of programing a laboratory plotter that can be equipped with the use of available electronic parts. During the analyses, the power, time, and resolution of the plotter drawing values must be assigned to create the designed engravings. The aim of the analyses was to obtain the accuracy of the laser plotter for the intended use for technical application of engraving; it was proposed to select an electric motor, laser diode, electronic parts, and a simple Arduino computer that could be combined in a student laboratory to obtain the planned results. The publication presents the results and simplified analysis needed to create a characterization of the components of the laser plotter equipped.

articleTitle: Study on Manufacturing of High Purity thin Iron Foil
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Thin metallic sheets and foils find applications in many industrial and consumer products. In the present work, cold rolling technique has been employed for manufacturing of High Purity Iron foil (with purity of 99.99%). Experimental study is performed by cold rolling a thin strip from thickness of 3 mm to 1 mm with a conventional rolling mill. The thin strips were prepared by electrolytic deposition of high purity iron powder (99.99% pure) within 4.5 days washing cycle followed by annealing process. Further a two-high Rolling mill was used for rolling the test specimens. The influence of annealing temperature, soaking time and rolling passes on the specimen were studied. Results show that there is a tendency of crack formation as temperature of specimen decreased during rolling. Maximum reduction in thickness up to 66.67% was achieved.

articleTitle: Automated ARM CPU-Based Cloud System for the Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, we present an autonomous automated cloud platform based on Raspberry Pi-s for the Industrial Internet of Things. The system is based on hardware virtualization technology with the use of VMware ESXi technology, Nexus Repository, and Jenkins.

articleTitle: Application of FEM with Piecewise Mittag-Leffler Functions Basis for the Linear Elasticity Problem in Materials with Fractal Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Mathematical model of the linear elasticity problem for capillary-porous materials with fractal structure is constructed. Integro-differentiation apparatus of fractional order to account the fractal structure of the material in the ratios of linear elasticity was used. A variational formulation of the linear elasticity problem for capillary-porous materials with fractal structure was obtained. Using the basis of the Mittag-Leffler piecewise functions to obtain an approximate solution of the problem of finding the minimum of the full potential energy functional was proposed. For partial cases the obtained results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Software and Algorithmic Aspects of Parallel Calculation of Non-Isothermal Moisture Transfer in Fractal-Structure Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A new mathematical model of the nonstationary process of heat and moisture transfer in the two-dimensional region is constructed on the basis of the use of Kaputo and Grunwald-Letnikov derivatives. An implicit finite-difference scheme for approximation of a mathematical model of noisothermal moisture transfer taking into account the fractional integro-differential apparatus is developed. The given algorithm of numerical realization of model allows to receive values of function of temperature and humidity for all points of area of partition. The method of fractional steps is adapted for numerical realization of mathematical model. It allowed performing parallel calculations of two difference half-step taking into account the corresponding spatial coordinate. An analysis of parallel solutions on multi-core computers has been performed. The software a parallel algorithm using .Net threads and algorithmic features of the TPL library has developed. It has been tested on multi-core computer systems with CPUs of different capacities. The analysis of acceleration and efficiency of the algorithm on the basis of the constructed graphs is carried out.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Microfluidic Lab-chip for Detecting Heavy Metals in Water Samples
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This research analyzes the main design parameters of microfluidic lab-chip device dedicated for detecting heavy metals in water samples. Mathematical model of a potentiometric microfluidic sensor, which includes the heat and mass transfer, fluid flow and ion exchange processes was developed and solved by FEM CAE tool.

articleTitle: Equations of State Variables of Electromagnetic Circuits in Engineering Education of MEMS-Specialists
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: It is proposed to form for the method of state variables of differential levels of electromagnetic circuits with branched electric and magnetic sub-circuits. Differential equations are formed in relation to independent variables: voltages of capacitors of ribs, currents of the chord of the graph of the electric sub-circuit and magnetic fluxes of the chord of the graph of the magnetic sub-circuit. The method of analysis is the basis for the construction of modern circuit and circuit-field mathematical models of electrical and electromechanical devices. In this case, the differential equations of these devices are written in the normal Cauchy's form, focused on the further application of numerical methods for integrating differential equations using computer calculating tools. The method of analysis has passed strict testing in real applied problems of electromechanics, power engineering, computerized automation systems. An example is added: differential equations of a saturated double-winding transformer with a capacitive load.

articleTitle: Proposal of a Five Degrees-of-Freedom Manipulator as an Example of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Aim of the publication was to show the process of designing and building a manipulator with five degrees of freedom with a structure adapted to manual control by a controller. The publication describes the problem of a manipulator that uses solutions used in industrial robots, but on a scale that allows it to be used in a small workplace in laboratories. The functionalities allowing automating repetitive activities are shown. The aim of the project was to show the possibility of using embedded systems applications in engineering education. The MIT App Inventor software was used for programing.

articleTitle: Scattering Properties of Microantenna Based on an Array Consisting of Thin Wires
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The analytical basis for the modeling the miniature antenna constructed of array of thin metallic wires is presented in paper. The diffraction problem is considered using the asymptotic approach, which foresees getting the explicit formula for the electromagnetic (EM) field components. This allows us to get the simple formula for the radiation pattern (RP) of system and to formulate the optimizing problem on the search of optimal geometry and parameters of antenna. The computational results demonstrate the potential to obtain the RPs of the different form that makes the possible to use of such kind antenna for the different MEMS applications.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Noise Signals in Wavelet Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The existing types of noise, which are based on different physical sources, are analyzed. The assessment of the influence of thermal noise on the quality of signal transmission is substantiated. The main statistical characteristics of noise signals are considered. An estimate of the instantaneous values of noise signals in the wavelet region is proposed. A wavelet representation of the energy characteristics of noise signals is recorded. The simulation of the process of estimating the power of noise signals using their wavelet transforms is performed.

articleTitle: Efficiency Use of Flow Digital Methods of Measure Signals Pre-Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Increasing the productivity of information sources necessitates the improvement of existing and development of new digital methods and algorithms for measuring signals flow processing. This situation is explained by the presence of measuring signals distortions. The causes of such distortions are transients in the sensor element, ADC quantization noise, information channel noise, etc. Thus, increasing the speed of measuring signals formation leads to a decrease in the accuracy of measurement.One of the options for solving this problem may be the use of statistical methods of measured signals pre-processing. The experiments were performed on the example of an IR distance sensor SHARP-2Y0A21. The mentioned sensor allows to change the speed of generating measuring signals. According to the results of experiments, the expediency of using sliding methods of pre-processing sequential fragments of senor signals is analyzed. In particular, the methods of calculating the sliding values are considered: the average, the medians and the first-order filters with different parameters. The use of signal pre-processing sliding methods does not change the information performance of measuring transducers.

articleTitle: Modeling of Linear Electromagnetic Damper for Walking Assistance and Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper presents the mathematical modeling and numerical simulation of a linear electromagnetic damper whose purpose is to assist the user during walking while harvesting energy. The proposed damper is based on the linear tubular permanent magnet generator and its application in wave energy conversion systems. It consists of a set of permanent magnets that move freely with respect to a series of air coils inside a housing made of magnetic iron PLA. The device is modeled ana analysis using lumped equivalent magnetic circuit (LEMC) and finite element method (FEM).

articleTitle: Design of Electrochemical Reactor for Manufacturing Aluminum Oxide Nanoporous Membrane
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Aluminum oxide nanoporous membranes are attractive in different fields and could be used for a variety of purposes. To produce nanomembrane with controlled pore areas, it is important to design an electrochemical reactor. During anodization, temperature is one of the most significant parameters. Accordingly, it is important to ensure a uniform mixing process to maintain a constant temperature throughout the anodization process in reactor. In this work, six different impellers were designed for the mixing process of an electrochemical reactor with a vibrating functional element. Simulations of the mixing process with different impellers in a novel reactor were performed. Results showed that the design of the impeller influences the mixing process because the flow velocity is highly dependent on impeller geometry. The observed results will be useful for further development of novel electrochemical reactor with vibrating functional element for manufacturing aluminum oxide nanoporous membranes in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of a Gutter-Cleaning Robot as an Example of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Aim of the publication was to show the process of designing, building, and programing a device for cleaning gutters. The publication describes the issue of engineering education. The task of the work is to make the entire structure in 3D printing and retrofitting with standard elements. During the analysis, the focus was on the implementation of the device with the longest possible operating time without the need to recharge and adapting the device to the easiest access to spare parts to modify the components to be more effective. The publication presents the results of engineering education in the field of computer science and information technology.

articleTitle: Experimental Solar-Based Rechargeable Battery Charger as an Example of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Aim of the publication was to show the process of designing, building, and programing an experimental portable charger for lithium-ion cells using a low-power photovoltaic panel, a microcontroller with dedicated modules for this microcontroller for educational applications. The publication shows the issue of engineering education, emphasizes the full integration of textbook learning methods, hardware, software, and methods of using them in the teaching of a modern engineer. During the analyse, the design of the device was made using CAD software, the elements were printed in 3D printing technology, electronic systems were created, components were assembled, the microcontroller was programmed, and the device was tested. The aim of the project was to show the possibility of using information technology in engineering education.

articleTitle: Parallel Computing Algorithm and Visualization of Particles wave Functions in a Quantum System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article presents the procedure for solving a comlex computational scientific problem and visualization of the obtained results. The effect of the magnetic field was taken into account in calculations. This procedure is a clear example of mutual integration and combination of own developed software and existing specialized mathematical editors. The article demonstrates the advantages of developed specialized software for interactive graphics and physical visualization at the basic initial stage. The results of theoretical research in this article can be useful for experimental.

articleTitle: Magnetoconductance of Polycrystalline Silicon in SemOI-structures for Sensors Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The work is based on research magnetotoconductance polysilicon layer in SemOI-structures, which are under the influence of a magnetic field up to 14 T at temperatures of liquefied helium. The samples were subjected to deformation to determine the effect of material dispersion on low-temperature conductivity. Considered occurrence from capacitive relative magnetic conductivity at liquefied helium temperatures is caused by superposition of charge carriers at low temperatures in magnetic fields with Bcr ~ 3T in the framework of the quantum transfer mechanism model. The determined concentration of polysilicon samples must be used in the development of sensors of mechanical quantities, operational in difficult operating conditions, namely under the influence of deformation in strong magnetic fields up to 14T at temperatures of 4.2 K.

articleTitle: Discrete Modelling of System Statistical Parameters by Fibonacci Probability Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the formulas for Fibonacci distribution and golden proportion regularities in oscillation spectra of oscillator systems are presented in frame of MEMS elements parameters probabilistic discrete modeling. Established ratios allow to calculate the statistical mean, standard deviation and confidence limits of system parameters.

articleTitle: A Model Analysis for Embedded Control of Known Continuous-Time Scalar Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A model operation for embedded control of known affine scalar continuous-time nonlinear systems is analyzed. The model is described by algebraic equation with variable structure. Sliding modes of the controlled system states based on the model are analyzed. Conditions for correct functioning of the controlled system using the model in the presence of disturbances of its nonlinearities are derived. The model does not require any training procedure and is of moderate complexity. Applications of the model to the control of non-holonomic system and to the control of permanent-magnet linear motor used for precise repetitive positioning are simulated.

Index Terms: Solution Of The Optimal Control Problem

articleTitle: Numerical and Experimental Investigation of Micro Matrix Hot Embossing Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A structure whose characteristic dimensions are on a microscale is called microstructure. To take advantage of their unique properties, these structures are used in a variety of fields. Whereas, the structure is on a micro-scale, it is difficult to use traditional manufacturing methods. There are many developed methods that can be used to form a microstructure. However, most of them are long lasting and difficult to control. In this study, the structure was formed very efficiently using the hot embossing method. This process was also simulated using a finite element model. The obtained results of structure formation will possibly be applied in further research.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Approach to Design of New Medical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility of algorithmic design of complex electronic medical equipment. Such equipment is considered as an element of the biotechnical system, which is a separate variant of the cyber-physical system. A biotech system includes a biological object, electronic medical equipment, and a potential user. Design of electronic medical equipment is complex and depends on the characteristics of the biotechnical system, hence development of each new piece of such equipment requires an individual approach. However, the analysis of possible generalized structures of biotechnical systems and features of their elements enables systematizing of operations sequences necessary for their creation as well as proposes a design algorithm allowing to obtain the desired result. We consider such algorithmic approach on the example of the design of new medical equipment based on bio-electrical impedancemetry. The obtained results can be used in the design of biotechnical systems for therapeutic purposes.

articleTitle: Investigation and Animation of Spring Dynamic Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Animations of complex mechanical systems with repetitive movements of interest in terms of activation of imagination in their study and research. Action of the spring dynamic absorber, investigation of the physical quantities of proposed mathematical model was implementated using non-linear Runge-Kutta type methods. Two kinds of methods: a nested method of relative accuracy 3(2) and two-sided method with accuracy 2 are consruted in proposed paper. Also estimation of main term of local error are obtained. For all these algorithms, in contrast to other algorithms, only three calls to the right-hand side of the differential equation are required.

articleTitle: Development of a Small-Scale Laboratory Centrifuge as an Example of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Aim of the publication was to show the process of designing, building, and programing a laboratory centrifuge, consisting of an electric motor, a timer, and a speed controller, for educational applications. The another aim of the project was to show the possibility of using information technology in engineering education. The publication describes the issue of programing a laboratory centrifuge that can be equipped with the use of available electronic parts. During the analyses, the rotational speed values that must be assigned to the centrifuge to create platelet-rich fibrins were calculated. The aim of the analyses was to obtain the accuracy of the centrifuge in the intended use for medicine, it was proposed to select an electric motor, timer and speed controller, which could be combined in a student laboratory to obtain the planned results. The publication presents the results and simplified calculations needed to create platelet-rich fibrins.

articleTitle: Optical Sensor Based on Data Fusion Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This work is devoted to developing a sensing element based on liquid crystal material CLC2103L and cholesteric liquid crystal BLO-62 with nematic 5CB. The multiparameter optical sensor with wide functionality with the use of the offered sensitive element is practically realized.

articleTitle: Selected Possibility of Using MEMS to Assess the Demand and Transmission Capacity of Electric Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The development and expansion of power grids is now a priority direction for many countries. In order to optimize processes and increase the reliability of power grids operation, MEMS technologies should be used, which can ensure this. Therefore, this article will present the possibilities of developing MEMS for the assessment of the demand and transmission capacity of power systems. The proposal contained in this article will concern the analysis of the change in power demand over time and transmission limitations caused by the peculiarities of overhead lines and power stations.In this article, the methodology for assessing the capacity of the power grid will be analyzed in detail on the example of a medium voltage overhead line with a rated voltage of 30 kV. In addition, the proposed methodology provides for its use in order to analyze power grids in terms of other rated voltages (110 kV, 220 kV, etc.)

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of the Performance of Implementing a Java Application Based on the Microservices Architecture, for Various AWS EC2 Instances
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The IT industry is growing rapidly. Therefore, changes in the application deployment area take place very often. Developers need to adjust to the new solutions; however, the multitude of available tools may make it difficult to choose the best one. The article presents a summary of 3 AWS EC2 instances and their performance for various test cases running on a java, microservices based application. The purpose of the analysis was to indicate what should be followed when choosing the appropriate environment for the implemented application.

articleTitle: Numerical Calculation of the Electromagnetic Torque of an Induction Motor with a Hollow Rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: As a result of multivariate finite element calculations, the dependences of the rated and starting moments of the induction motor were obtained with varying the diameter and perforations number of the hollow rotor. From the obtained dependencies consideration, it follows that rotor's perforations affect the induction motor's mechanical characteristic like a decrease in voltage at the terminals of the stator winding.

articleTitle: Prediction of Resonant Thermomechanical Behavior of Bimetallic Plates under the Action of Amplitude-Modulated Radio Impulse
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A physical and mathematical model of the thermomechanical behavior of a bimetallic plate under the action of impulse electromagnetic fields with amplitude modulation is proposed. Based on this model, computer prediction of the resonant thermomechanical behavior of a bimetallic plate under the action of an amplitude-modulated radio impulse depending on its amplitude-frequency characteristics is performed.

articleTitle: Modelling of Heat Transfer in Particle and Fiber Reinforced Composite Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This article describes different approaches of heat transfer modelling in composite materials. Particularly, the specific properties of particle reinforced composites what set requirements for the modeling methods are presented. Fourier's law, Boltzmann transport equation and Molecular dynamics are compared as approaches for solving of heat transfer problem. The area of application, advantages and limitation of the methods are presented.

articleTitle: Construction of Asynchronous Cell-Automatic Model for Research the Thermal Mass Transfer Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This work is devoted to the study changes in temperature and moisture content in anisotropic materials using cellular automata. To do this, in this paper the developed model of asynchronous cellular automata, which makes it possible to change the numerical values of cells that selected randomly, is described. In this case, the new values used as input data when we calculate the values of neighboring cells. After that an experiment by using this model was performed. Then a numerical solution of a similar problem was performed. In this case, we use an explicit difference scheme and a three-dimensional mathematical model. This model is described by using a system of differential equations in partial derivatives in spatial coordinates and time. To verify the adequacy of the results, the average absolute error was determined. The obtained error value allows us to determine the feasibility of using cellular automata in solving such problems of thermal conductivity.

articleTitle: Some Aspects on [numerical] Stability of Evolution Equations of Stiff Type; Use of Computer Algebra
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: We are dealing with stiffness phenomena in initial value problems for systems of ordinary differential equations. Such problems appear in many physical applications, for instance, in the modeling of the evolution in time of mechanical systems or of electronic devices. A general theory of stiffness effects is not given here. Rather, several concrete examples are discussed in order to support understanding such effects. Use of computer algebra is also a relevant issue of it. For numerical examples we refer to the relevant literature (see References).

articleTitle: Radius Measurements of Angular Bearing Raceways in the Context of Analytical Computations of Contact Interactions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article presents digitization methods with focus on the applied solution (CMM machine equipped with an active scanning head VastXT). The paper describes thoroughly the way the geometrical information was collected, and the methods used for determination of interesting parameters. The second part deals with analytical methods applied during the investigation and the obtained results referring to the radius of the raceway and its impact on the contact stiffness, contact angles and contact forces of spindle bearings.

articleTitle: Approximation of PM DC Micromotor Transfer Function by Fractional Order Transfer Function
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE XVIIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Transfer function of permanent magnets (PM) DC micromotor speed is quite complex, which in turn complicates the synthesis of automatic control systems. It is established that for this class of micromotors the electromechanical time constant becomes commensurate with the electric time constant of the armature, which leads to overshooting of the output coordinate, so simplification of transfer function of speed by discarding the s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> component will result in aperiodic process and considerable accuracy loss. A series of experimental PM DC micromotor studies using a high-precision laser tachometer to obtain the necessary parameters for the high-accuracy micromotor model development have been carried out. The developed high-accuracy model made it possible to obtain the appropriate transition process of speed with overshooting. Approximation of complex transfer function of PM DC micromotor speed by a more compact fractional order transfer function using the intelligent particle swarm optimization method has been performed, and the approximation accuracy has been estimated on the basis of transition and frequency characteristics analysis.
